text: The Cecil Community Centre Board of Management Board of Management has a vacancy as Stanley Ing is unexpectedly unable to complete his term. The Centre has nominated Sebastian Martinez to take Mr. Ing’s place on the Board. On behalf of the Cecil Community Centre I am submitting this appointment as new business as it was submitted to the City but did not make the agenda closing for this meeting. A letter from the Executive Director is attached, and approving this appointment at this meeting will restore the board to full strength.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed Sebastian Martinez to the Cecil Community Centre Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending June 30, 2025, and until a successor is appointed.
